notes: restore-required because of oca-addons/contract 18.0.2.0.0. That migration is an OCA major-version restructure: it moves a dozen contract.line fields out to contract_line_successor and contract_termination, deletes the contract_template_line_form_view, and removes ir_model rows for four abstract models. Once it has run, the previous image is looking for fields and a view that are no longer where it expects them, so rolling the image back does not roll the database back. Recovery from a failed upgrade is restore-from-backup, not image revert. Every other migration in this release is additive -- the Majal ones write data and install record rules, the remaining OCA ones add columns -- and on their own would have been forward-compatible. Note the trigger: this only fires when upgrading a database whose contract module predates 18.0.2.0.0. A first install on an empty database registers 18.0.2.0.0 directly and runs no migration at all, so the first go-live deployment is not exposed to it. majal_demo 18.0.2.0.2 re-invokes its idempotent acceptance-data seeder on upgrade so databases carrying an older majal_demo receive the Property, office, approval and signing records plus the complete AI provider catalogue for every synthetic demo company. It creates records and changes no schema, so it does not move the flag; the flag remains restore-required for the OCA contract reason above. Operationally, upgrading a database that has majal_demo installed seeds or refreshes the synthetic acceptance dataset.
